description: Reads the moderation log, newest first: moderators named or removed, bans, flags, and room messages, inbox messages and community entries taken down by someone other than their author. Off by default and records nothing while off (`on` says): turn it on with neblla_update_app moderationLog: true, then neblla_promote save. Lines: kind, by (who), target, room, detail, at (when).

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

name: neblla_get_moderation_log
title: Read the moderation log
